thread:
Maya: Heads up — the v2 rollout probe found an odd edge where tenant pinning + quota-shim causes requests to sometimes still hit v1. Not huge volume but reproducible in shadow cohort.
Chris: repro steps?
Maya: quick: tenant A has pin set to v2 in console, but they also have a legacy API key and our header fallback path triggers when header missing. If client sends old key we proxy and header gets rewritten to v1. Seen after the proxy refactor.
Eli: ah yeah, that's the `header->token` mapping we changed last month. We added a fallback for backward compatibility. Can you paste a minimal log?
Maya: snippet from router logs:
```
[router] recv req tenant=tenantA src=proxy-legacy header=X-Api-Version: (missing)
[router] map key->version => v1
[router] route tenant=tenantA version=v1 route=pool-legacy
```
Chris: ugh. So tenant pin wins only if request explicitly carries version signal. Console pinning sets desired model but our fallback has higher precedence. That's wrong.
Jun: re: UX — if console shows tenant pinned to v2 we should never silently downgrade without a console notice and telemetry event.
Maya: agreed. Current telemetry logs only show final route, not the decision path. Need both.
Eli: proposed quick fix: add a routing-decision trace that emits an event when pin mismatch + fallback occurs. Minimal change: when pin exists and chosen route != pin, emit `pin_override` event to telemetry pipeline.
Chris: sounds fine. Any perf or cost impact? Extra event is tiny.
Maya: we also need a console affordance: a banner on tenant config when there have been N pin overrides in last 24h. Operators should be able to drill into examples.
Jun: +1 for drilldown. Also add an action to surface a sample request (redacted) and a 'recommended fix' CTA that links to docs.
Eli: implementation sketch:
```
routing.decision_trace.emit({tenant, requested_sig, pin, chosen_route, reason})
```
and console query: `events where tenant==X and reason=="pin_mismatch"`
Chris: careful with PII — must redact user-provided prompt and keys. Only surface method/path, headers, and sampling id.
Maya: noted. Also need to consider quota calculation: if we downgrade to v1 the quota charged should follow the route used, but billing UX shows pinned model licensing. Need alignment.
Jun: billing/console product ask: if pin exists we should show both "intended model" and "actual served model" with costs side-by-side for sampled requests.
Eli: ok. For rollout plan: fix routing precedence in staging, add decision_trace telemetry, add console banner + drilldown, then run a 24h shadow to compare actuals before removing fallback.
Chris: timeline?
Eli: patch for precedence + trace in 2 days, dashboard wire in 3, staging rollout same week. Canaries to 1% next Tues, 10% Wed, full after 48h observation.
Maya: do we need a migration flag in console to opt-in for strict-pin-mode? Some customers prefer strict enforcement.
Jun: yes, make it a toggle (strict pin = true/false) with default=false. When true, route will 403 if mismatch, and we notify the client via header `X-Redwood-Pin-Enforced: 1`.
Chris: add docs and SDK note: clients might see 403 if relying on auto-fallback.
Maya: example header we plan to check:
```
X-Redwood-Client-Version: 2
X-Redwood-Tenant-Pref: v2
```
Eli: for telemetry sampling add a field `sampling_id` so console can fetch example. Sampling rate 1% for live environment, 100% in staging.
Jun: ok. I'll open a console PR for the banner and toggle copy. Maya/Eli, can you add the router changes to the patch and link to my doc?
Maya: will do. I'll include test cases: pinned+missing-header, pinned+legacy-key, strict-pin-mode behavior.
deploy-bot: Deployment queued: router/v2-precedence-fix -> staging (sha: d4f8a2c) :rocket:
Chris: quick note — add a metric for `pin_override_count` per-tenant and a per-route histogram of latency so we can detect regressions post-fix.
Eli: adding metric names to patch: `routing.pin_override_total` and `routing.pin_override_latency_ms`.
Jun: thanks. I'll coordinate console rollout with Product and notify support. Let's loop back after the 48h canary.
Maya: perfect. I'll create the follow-up thread with test results once staging runs.
Chris: thanks all :thumbsup:
